identity.description:
Crew merges on the principal's word (T74)

## Summary

The written rule said a human merges and crew never does, and the run stopped before any action on main. In practice you ask crew to merge all the time, and PR 100 was merged that way. The rule now says crew merges only when you tell it to. The delivered window gains a merge request: on your word the project lead runs the merge with the repo's own method, writes one line in its decisions file, and still asks whether the work shipped. The escalation trigger for actions on main says a merge you asked for is the answer, not the trigger.

**Ticket:** [T74 — Crew merges on the principal's word](https://github.com/jerridan/crew/blob/main/docs/tickets.md#t74--crew-merges-on-the-principals-word)
**Type:** New feature

---

## Agent context

### Authority

- `docs/design.md` §15.105 (this change) and §15.92 (the delivered window).
- `skills/delivered-window/SKILL.md` owns the merge request, as one of the five kinds of message the window sorts.
- `skills/project-lead/references/autonomy-contract.md` owns escalation trigger 4, which now excludes a merge the principal asked for.

### What changed, by file

- `skills/delivered-window/SKILL.md`: "A merge request" section before "The word that the work shipped"; "Five kinds of message"; four passages tightened to keep the body under 500 lines (499).
- `skills/project-lead/references/autonomy-contract.md`: trigger 4 gains one sentence.
- `CLAUDE.md`: the Workflow line says crew merges only when the principal says to.
- `README.md`: the three sentences that said you merge or crew never merges now say you can tell the project lead to merge.
- `docs/design.md`: §15.105.
- `docs/tickets.md`: T74, closed in this PR, not run.
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`: 0.1.82 to 0.1.83.

### Constraints that applied

- One rule in one file: the merge command and its order live in the skill; CLAUDE.md, the README and trigger 4 point at it in one sentence each.
- The skill body stays under 500 lines: 499 after four trims of reasoning sentences whose rules remain.
- Version bump in both manifests, equal.
- ASD-STE100; "project lead" in full; no mermaid.
- Nothing claims a run exercised the merge request: PR 100 was merged by this session before the rule existed, and §15.105 says so.

### How this was verified

Reading only: the diff against the three sentences the principal named, the skill's section order, and the `wc -l` of the skill body (499) and `CLAUDE.md` (190). The stale-status sweep over the added lines found nothing. This PR was written directly by the project-lead session of PR 100 at the principal's request, not by a crew run, so no IC report and no skeptical review exist for it; the CI reviewer runs on it.

### Known gaps

- No run has exercised "A merge request".
